item: row 329: a restore never follows a volume swapped for a link after its check
summary: decrypt_stream, stream_key_opens and decrypt_file take follow_links and identity; the stream restore, its verify and the oo-volumes-1 reassembly open backup-folder volumes without following a link and only as the very file the checksum pass hashed (dev, inode, size, mtime, ctime of the hashing handle); a volume parity rebuilt is hashed again before it is read; the wrong-key probe takes its key check and its checksum from one file, so the right passphrase never reads as wrong; a refusal fails closed and never reads as a wrong passphrase; the app's own sealed files keep following links.
